content.title: Move between the Open Account and Calculators pages
content.description: A visitor uses the persistent bank header to move between the site’s main account-opening and calculator areas without relying on the browser’s back button, including navigating from the Calculators page to the Open Account page.
content.summary: Navigate between the site’s two main banking areas.
content.value: Supports exploration across related banking tools without forcing browser-back navigation.
criteria: the bank header is present on both the Open Account page and the Calculators page
from the Calculators page, the header link to Open Account navigates to `/bank-clone-app/open-account`
